unit: Unit 8 ~ Unit 10 现在完成时专题
summary: 表示过去发生的动作对现在造成影响，或从过去持续到现在的状态：have / has + 过去分词。

rules.title: 结构：have / has + 过去分词
rules.detail: 第三人称单数用 has，其余用 have。过去分词：规则动词同过去式（+ed），不规则要记（go → gone，see → seen，do → done，be → been）。

examples.en: I have finished my homework already.

examples.zh: 自从 2015 年她就住在这里。

rules.title: 两大用法
rules.detail: ① 影响用法：过去做的事对现在有影响（I have lost my key. 我把钥匙丢了——所以现在进不去门）。② 持续用法：动作从过去开始延续到现在，常与 for + 时间段、since + 时间点 连用。

examples.zh: 他去上海了（人现在不在这里）。

examples.en: We have known each other for ten years.

rules.title: have been to 与 have gone to 的区别
rules.detail: have been to：去过（已回来）；have gone to：去了（还没回来）。He has been to Beijing twice. 他去过北京两次；He has gone to Beijing. 他去北京了。

examples.en: Have you ever been to the Great Wall?
Tom has gone to the library, so he isn't here.
examples.zh: 汤姆去图书馆了，所以他不在这儿。

pitfalls: for / since 混淆：for + 时间段（for three years）；since + 时间点（since 2020, since he left）
非延续动词不能与时间段连用：❌ He has died for two years. → ✓ He has been dead for two years.
have gone to 和 have been to 混用：have gone to 是「去了没回来」，主语不能是第一/二人称的问句场景

questions.stem: — Where is Mr. Green? — He ___ to London on business.
questions.explain: 他不在现场说明「去了还没回来」，用 has gone to。

questions.stem: My parents ___ in this city since they got married.
questions.explain: since 从句提示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时 have lived。

questions.stem: — Have you ___ been to Hong Kong? — No, never.
questions.explain: 问「曾经是否去过」用 ever；never 对应回答。

questions.stem: His grandfather has ___ for five years.
questions.explain: die 是非延续动词，不能与 for five years 连用；要转成延续状态 been dead。
already 提示现在完成时；read 的过去分词仍是 read。

questions.stem: She has ___ (be) a nurse for ten years.
questions.explain: for ten years 持续用法：has been a nurse。

questions.stem: They have knew each other since childhood.
questions.explain: 现在完成时要用过去分词：know → knew → known。

questions.stem: 我已经学英语五年了。（翻译整句）
answer: i have learned english for five years.
i have studied english for five years.
i have learnt english for five years.
questions.explain: for + 时间段用现在完成时；learn 过去分词 learned / learnt 均可。

questions.stem: 你曾经去过上海吗？（翻译整句）
answer: have you ever been to shanghai?
questions.explain: 「去过（已回来）」用 have been to；ever 加强语气。
